# world: # written by Opus 5.5 16.11.26 for LISA-13. Same 10-column schema as content/vocab.tsv; world = countries. EN bare noun (as existing rows), PT-PT/DE with article; plurals use 'Where are'/'Onde estão'/'Wo sind' like socks/gloves.

# Emoji column is only a picture-type marker (build_data.py ignores the character and loads app/img/<id>.svg); every row needs its original SVG. Do NOT let fetch_images.py leave Noto placeholders for: custard_tart (🥧 is a pie), gondola (🛶 is a canoe), eiffel_tower (🗼 is Tokyo Tower), pyramid (🔺 is a red triangle), sausage (🌭 is a hot dog; draw a plain sausage), cowboy_hat (🤠 is a face; draw the hat only), camel (draw ONE hump, Egyptian dromedary), clock (clock face must dominate, e.g. Big Ben dial).

# Distractor pairs to keep off the same question (same picture idea or near-identical word): country_sardine~fish (both 🐟), country_football~ball (both ⚽; PT a bola / a bola de futebol), country_cherry_blossom~flower (both 🌸), country_bear~teddy (PT o urso / o ursinho, DE Bär / Teddybär), country_forest~tree, country_forest~country_rainforest (DE Wald / Regenwald, PT floresta / floresta tropical), country_gondola~boat, country_baguette~bread, country_custard_tart~cake, country_rice_ball~ball (PT a bola de arroz), country_eiffel_tower~country_skyscraper (both tall towers).

# Word choices: castle = die Burg (fortified castle, same as LISA-15 RESEARCH), tram = o elétrico/die Straßenbahn (LISA-15), Russian doll = British term (Cambridge: UK 'Russian doll', US 'nesting doll'), PT a matriosca (Priberam entry), dumplings = os dumplings (current PT-PT usage per Time Out Lisboa; alt 'os raviólis chineses'), arranha-céus = masc. invariable (Priberam), pasta = PT a massa / DE die Nudeln (everyday child words), custard tart DE das Puddingtörtchen (descriptive; 'Pastel de Nata' also used in DE shops).
